description: §7.3.5 (S480) — two unread `<each>` binders, each W-UNUSED-BINDING (a Warning): `r` of a flat `<each … as r>` whose row reads nothing, and `cell` of a nested `<each>` whose row reads only the outer binder. The outer `row` is read (`title=row.name`, and as the inner `in=`) and is not reported. The program compiles; the warnings do not change it.
rationale: §7.3.5: "The name an `<each>` binds with `as name` (§17.7.2, §17.7.3) that nothing in the row reads … SHALL be reported as W-UNUSED-BINDING." One report per binder.

codes: severity:code 'W-UNUSED-BINDING' did not fire (expected severity warning)
